name: Mr. Frost
appearance: A quiet, dry-humoured gentleman of minor estate, more at ease among his books than in company, with an ironic light in his eye.
definition: Arabella's father — minor gentry of small fortune, a sharp mind who honed his daughter's wit in his own library. Detached and amused by the follies of the marriage market, he indulges Arabella's cleverness where his wife despairs of it.
voice: Dry, ironic and economical, fond of the sly aside; he says little but rarely wastes a word.
